facts.text: A Phoenix find, near Nick's yoga studio.
facts.why: Nick is at a yoga studio and later a yoga retreat in Phoenix, but no scene has a food stop near either, so the claim is unproven.
facts.fix: A Phoenix find, for Noelle's first taste of the desert.

vibe.verdict: A tidy Christmas tea room with the right names, but it leans on Phoenix and Snowcone and skips the film's best jokes.
missing: Sleigh and reindeer parked at Desert Ridge Marketplace (arrival in Phoenix)
Snowcone the reindeer bringing Mrs Claus's letter (mall)
Gabriel's naughty-or-nice algorithm finding only 2,837 nice children (North Pole)
Nick at the yoga retreat in the Desert Botanical Garden
Noelle suddenly understanding other languages and sign language (Phoenix)
Nick trying out as a mall Santa (Desert Ridge)
ideas: Swap 'Gingerbread latte' for a 'Naughty or nice hot chocolate' with a note about Gabriel's list of 2,837 nice kids.
Swap 'Children's tea served with a wink' for 'Reindeer parking at the mall, ask for Snowcone'.
Swap the printed 'Sopapillas with honey' house line for a yoga-retreat green smoothie, since Nick hides at a retreat.
Add a mall Santa photo line to the cake trolley caption in place of 'Mind the cake trolley on your way in'.
